models.name: discussion_board_users
models.description: Registered end user identities for the discussion board system. Stores essential login credentials, profile settings, and personally identifiable information for authentication, display, and privacy compliance. All content authorship in articles and comments references this table for ownership and audit. Soft delete and lock states support GDPR, account recovery, and moderation. Distinct from admins – not polymorphic. Main entry point for all user/external actor flows.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address for login, notifications, and password resets.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication. Never stores raw plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Display name shown in user profile and for attribution to articles and comments.

plainFields.name: avatar_url
plainFields.description: Optional profile image/avatar for the user account, shown on article/comment listings. Nullable for accounts without avatar.

plainFields.name: is_locked
plainFields.description: Whether the user account is currently locked or suspended; used for moderation, bans, security, or PII retention logic.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Used to support GDPR-compliant removal/anonymization, and to hide former accounts without destroying content.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: User account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update timestamp.

models.name: discussion_board_user_sessions
models.description: Login session records for end users. Tracks stateless authentication events for account security, multi-device login, privacy audit, and session expiry support. Used in all authentication flows, account tracing, or action recovery. Each session references the corresponding user by foreign key. Follows strict session table field requirements.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address for the session. Used for audit and security review.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL/location of connection at session start. Useful for suspicious activity auditing.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer of connection or page prior to session creation. Used for basic session tracing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp, used for session reuse, timeouts, and analytics.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration time, or null if session still valid.

models.name: discussion_board_admins
models.description: Administrative identities for the discussion board platform. Stores credentials, email, profile, and lock state for privileged actors empowered to moderate, audit, and control system operations. Admins are separate from users to keep permissions and audit trails clear. All moderator actions reference this table. Soft deletion, lock, and audit state fields for platform compliance. Not polymorphic.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's unique email address for privileged login, escalation notices, and audit traceability.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for administrator login. No stored plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Admin's display name for moderator tools, platform audit logs, and transparency.

plainFields.name: avatar_url
plainFields.description: Optional admin avatar/profile picture, for team identification in logs and UIs. Nullable for accounts without avatar.

plainFields.name: is_locked
plainFields.description: Indicates locked, banned, or suspended admin account status. Used to prevent privileged access abuse or investigation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of soft deletion for GDPR or key rotation purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Administrator account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last time the admin profile was modified.

models.name: discussion_board_admin_sessions
models.description: Session registry for all administrator logins, tracking server-side authentication for security, audit, and incident review. Each session references an admin actor and contains connection, time, and referrer context as required for proper GDPR and internal compliance. Composite index for session queries per admin actor, field set per session table pattern.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Session's originating IP for incident review and admin login traceability.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL for where the admin session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL or entry point for admin login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session timestamp for tracking session lifecycle and risk windows.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp, or null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description: Discussion board article (post) entity. Represents a user-authored article allowing text, optional attachments, and subsequent comments. Soft deletes are supported via deleted_at. Each article references a {@link discussion_board_users.id} as the author. Attachments are associated via {@link discussion_board_article_attachments}. Comments are stored separately for normalization and permission logic.

foreignFields.name: author_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who authored the article. {@link discussion_board_users.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title. Required, 1-100 characters per business rule.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main article text body. Required, 1-10000 characters per business rule.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime this article was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime this article was most recently updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Datetime for soft delete (if present, article is deleted and hidden from normal user views).

models.name: discussion_board_article_attachments
models.description: Attachment (image or file) associated with a discussion board article. Each record is an uploaded file or image with metadata describing its character. Only articles (not comments) may have attachments. Enforces many-to-one relationship to {@link discussion_board_articles}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article this attachment belongs to. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: filename
plainFields.description: Original uploaded filename, including extension.

plainFields.name: kind
plainFields.description: Logical kind of attachment for business-level filtering. Expected values: 'image', 'document', 'archive', or similar. Enforced by business logic layer.

plainFields.name: mimetype
plainFields.description: MIME type of uploaded file, e.g. 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf'. Used for download response and file type validation.

plainFields.name: filesize
plainFields.description: Size in bytes of the uploaded file. Must not exceed per-article and per-file limits (enforced in business logic).

plainFields.name: virus_scanned
plainFields.description: Whether this attachment passed virus/malware scan at upload time. True if safe, false or null otherwise.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Attachment creation datetime (upload time).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Attachment was deleted/removed from article (file is set for deletion). Nullable for current/active attachment.

models.name: discussion_board_article_comments
models.description: Discussion board article comment entity. Each record is a single comment authored by a user on an article. Represents independent user input. Comments are designed for independent moderation and permission checks. Deleted_at is soft delete (hidden from standard views, remains for audit/moderation). Each comment references its article and author.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article this comment belongs to. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment content/body. Required, limited to 1-1000 characters per business rule.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime this comment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime this comment was most recently updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Datetime for soft delete (if present, comment is deleted and hidden from common views).

models.name: discussion_board_abuse_reports
models.description: User-submitted abuse or inappropriate content report records. Each record logs the reporting user, targeted content (article or comment), category of abuse, detailed reason/explanation, current status (e.g., pending, closed, rejected), and all required timestamps. Provides the basis for administrative moderation workflow and compliance audits. Links only by reference to users and content IDs—no content duplication.

foreignFields.name: reporter_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reporter user's {@link discussion_board_users.id}. Identifies the user who submitted the abuse report.

foreignFields.name: target_article_id
foreignFields.description: Targeted article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id}. The article alleged for abuse, or null if the report concerns a comment only.

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Targeted comment's {@link discussion_board_article_comments.id}. The comment alleged for abuse, or null if the report concerns an article only.

plainFields.name: abuse_category
plainFields.description: Type/category of alleged abuse. Examples: 'spam', 'offensive', 'harassment', 'illegal', etc. Used for admin triage and reporting.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation/reason for the report as written by the reporter. Used for admin context and audit. Full-text search enabled for this field.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current report status. Examples: 'pending', 'in_review', 'closed', 'rejected'. Workflow state for moderation lifecycle.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of report submission. Used for triage order and audit trace.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last status update. Used for tracking processing progress.

models.name: discussion_board_moderation_actions
models.description: Administrative moderation actions including edits, hides, and deletions. Each record logs the moderated object (article or comment), the responsible admin, the action performed, the reason/justification (full text), affected content, timestamps, and references to original report if applicable. Used for compliance and regulatory trace. Immutable after creation except for audit notes.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. Identifies the administrator performing the moderation action.

foreignFields.name: target_article_id
foreignFields.description: Targeted article's {@link discussion_board_articles.id}. The article being moderated, or null if moderation concerns a comment only.

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Targeted comment's {@link discussion_board_article_comments.id}. The comment being moderated, or null if moderation concerns an article only.

foreignFields.name: abuse_report_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to abuse report {@link discussion_board_abuse_reports.id} if this action is in response to a prior user report. Null if direct moderation by admin.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of moderation action: 'edit', 'delete', 'hide', 'warn', etc. Business workflow enumeration.

plainFields.name: action_reason
plainFields.description: Full text of reason or justification for action (sysadmin/audit context).

plainFields.name: affected_data_ref
plainFields.description: Reference/summary of what data was affected by this action. May include a content hash, file reference, or summary string for audit trace.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of moderation action creation. Used for compliance trace and historical ordering.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update or audit annotation.

models.name: discussion_board_audit_logs
models.description: Append-only compliance/audit trail for all critical moderation actions. Immutable snapshot of moderation events for regulatory and incident review. Stores actor/admin, referenced object, action type, event details, and audit metadata. Not directly modifiable except by compliance staff in regulatory recovery. Retains complete historical record for all audits.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. Admin responsible for the action/event being audited.

foreignFields.name: target_article_id
foreignFields.description: Target article {@link discussion_board_articles.id} if the audit event references an article, else null.

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment {@link discussion_board_article_comments.id} if the audit event references a comment, else null.

foreignFields.name: moderation_action_id
foreignFields.description: Moderation action {@link discussion_board_moderation_actions.id} that this audit event corresponds to. Used for cross-traceability and integrity.

plainFields.name: audit_event_type
plainFields.description: Type of audit event (e.g., 'moderation_performed', 'compliance_override', 'manual_restore', etc.).

plainFields.name: audit_details
plainFields.description: Free-text audit log detail or justification. May include policy references or case numbers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of audit event creation.
